The potentiation by fluvoxamine and the three sigma-1 receptor agonists was blocked by co-administration of the selective sigma-1 receptor antagonist NE-100, suggesting that sigma-1 receptors play a role in blocking the enhancement of NGF-induced neurite outgrowth.
Moreover, the potentiation by SA4503 was blocked by co-administration of the IP3 receptor antagonist xestospongin C.
